summary: Amarc Resources filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) announcing CFO Carol Li stepped down effective September 15, 2026, with Braden Jensen, Corporate Controller, appointed interim CFO; Li remains as senior financial advisor for a smooth transition. The press release cites personal reasons and thanks her contributions. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed; the filing also notes a grant of 250,000 incentive stock options at $0.94 per share to VP Investor Relations Tom McMillan, subject to TSXV acceptance. Watch for a permanent CFO appointment and any related disclosure.
